entries.claim: One-way ANOVA partitions the total sum of squares into between-group and within-group components, SST = SSB + SSW
The F statistic is the ratio of the between-group mean square to the within-group mean square, with k-1 and N-k degrees of freedom
Tukey's HSD procedure compares all pairs of group means while controlling the family-wise error rate
Welch's ANOVA provides a test that does not assume equal variances, useful when group variances and sizes differ markedly
entries.notes: Motivates the robustness caveat in section 03

entries.claim: With m independent tests at level alpha, the family-wise error rate is 1-(1-alpha)^m, so six tests at 0.05 give about 26.5 percent
The exam means 72/80/75, the method-by-gender table, and the demo arrays with means -d, 0 and d are constructed teaching numbers
entries.notes: Not taken from any real experiment
